cohort: The study included 200 labours, initially limited to women personally cared for by the author, followed by a trust-wide analysis of labours.
finding: Epidural analgesia in labour was associated with a more than two-fold increased risk of emergency caesarean section, a trend observed in both the personal review and across the wider trust.
mod_finding: Epidural analgesia in labour was associated with an increased risk of emergency caesarean section.
